crossRefs.note: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you…
crossRefs.keyword: middle. Heb. navel. Meonenim. or, the regarders of thetimes

people.name: Diviners'_Oak
people.line: A tree near Shechem, associated with pagan divination practices.

people.name: Gaal
people.line: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.

translations.web: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”
translations.bsb: Then Gaal spoke up again, “Look, people are coming down from the center of the land, and one company is coming by way of the Diviners’ Oak.”
translations.kjv: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
translations.asv: And Gaal spake again and said, See, there come people down by the middle of the land, and one company cometh by the way of the oak of Meonenim.
